Rule Description: XP earned for participating in a match
Calculation Formula / Trigger: Every published match where player is in home or away team

Rule Description: XP earned for winning a match
XP earned for drawing a match

XP earned for each Man of the Match vote received

Calculation Formula / Trigger: Scoring at least 1 goal in 5 consecutive matches in a league
Making at least 1 assist in 5 consecutive matches in a league
Scoring 3 or more goals in 3 consecutive matches in a league
Winning a match while assigned as Home or Away Captain (3 times in a league)
Voted as Mentality and/or Defensive Impact player in 5 matches in a league
Top vote-getter in match votes (earned 3 times in a league)
Opponent scores 0 goals in match (earned 3 times in a league)
Playing in at least 90% of completed matches in a league
Winning 10 consecutive matches in a league
